title: Pretriangulated categories failing (TR4)
summary: We introduce gemstones in a pretriangulated category, which are used to perturb pretriangulated structures. For a triangulated category $\mathcal T$ whose stable category of coherent functors admits a gemstone, we construct pretriangulated structures on $\mathcal T$ which fail the octahedral axiom (TR4). This confirms a long-standing conjecture on triangulated categories.
